title: Homesite Reservation Schedule of Deposits, Premium Holding Fees and Accepted Payments
content:
This schedule lists, by premium class, the money a Homesite Reservation requires and the payment terms that apply to it. Amounts are in US dollars.

## Deposits and fees

| Premium class | Refundable reservation deposit | Premium holding fee (in addition to the deposit) | Calendar days after the reservation date for the full required funds |
|---|---|---|---|
| Interior Homesite | 1000.00 | 0.00 | 3 |
| Corner Homesite | 1500.00 | 0.00 | 3 |
| Cul-de-Sac Homesite | 2500.00 | 500.00 | 3 |
| Greenbelt Homesite | 5000.00 | 1500.00 | 2 |
| Water-View Homesite | 7500.00 | 2500.00 | 2 |
| Golf-Frontage Homesite | 10000.00 | 5000.00 | 2 |

The premium holding fee is refundable only as the release terms state, and it is credited to the lot premium on conversion.

## Payment terms

| Premium class | Accepted payment methods | Largest single card payment | Card convenience fee (percent of the card amount, rounded to the cent) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Interior Homesite | card, ACH, check | 1000.00 | 2.75 |
| Corner Homesite | card, ACH, check | 1500.00 | 2.75 |
| Cul-de-Sac Homesite | card, ACH, check, wire | 2500.00 | 2.75 |
| Greenbelt Homesite | ACH, check, wire | 2500.00 | 2.75 |
| Water-View Homesite | ACH, wire, certified funds | 2500.00 | 2.75 |
| Golf-Frontage Homesite | wire, certified funds | 2500.00 | 2.75 |

## Footnotes

1. The accepted payment methods are the methods accepted for reservation funds of that class. Card is not among the accepted methods for a Greenbelt Homesite, Water-View Homesite or Golf-Frontage Homesite, although a card cap figure is listed for those classes.
2. The card cap is the largest single card payment accepted toward the reservation.
3. The card convenience fee is charged on a card payment as a percent of the card amount and rounded to the cent.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A card payment of 400.00 on an Interior Homesite carries a convenience fee of 2.75 percent of 400.00, which is 11.00.
